LightningComponentBundle.description: A reusable data table component that can display data from various sources

property.name: title
property.label: Component Title
property.description: Title displayed in the component header

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: Icon to display in the component header

property.name: apexController
property.label: Direct Controller Name
property.description: Name of the Apex class implementing IGenericClass to call directly

property.name: controllerParams
property.label: Controller Parameters
property.description: the parameters for the Apex controller method

property.name: lmsTopic
property.label: LMS Topic
property.description: LMS topic to listen for data changes

property.name: configName
property.label: Configuration Name
property.description: Name of the static resource containing column configuration

property.name: keyField
property.label: Key Field
property.description: API name of the field to use as unique identifier

property.name: columnWidthsMode
property.label: Column Widths Mode
property.description: Mode for setting column widths, default to auto, can be fixed

property.name: showRowNumberColumn
property.label: Show Row Numbers
property.description: Display row numbers in the table

property.name: hideCheckboxColumn
property.label: Hide Checkboxes
property.description: Hide checkbox column for row selection

property.name: showActionsMenu
property.label: Show column Actions
property.description: Display column actions for each column
